canonical_project: National Data Centre for North Eastern Region (NDC-NER) / NICSI Assam Data Centre, Amingaon
owner: National Informatics Centre (NIC) via NICSI, Government of India (MeitY)
notes: PM Modi virtually inaugurated NDC-NER at Amingaon, North Guwahati (Kamrup district) on 14 Feb 2026; facility serves all 8 NE states as part of MeghRaj national government cloud. TOI (Dec 2020) reported ~Rs 350 crore cost; APDCL tender documents show dedicated 33 kV line and 3x2.5 MVA, 33/0.433 kV substation for NDC-NER Amingaon (confirming power build ~7.5 MVA sanctioned). First-round discovery cited 8.5 MW sanctioned power / 4 MW IT load / 200-400 racks / ~43,000 sq ft / Tier III N+1 / IGBC Gold. Government-owned DC; grade A for existence and status.
